title: Gallery Blackout
changes: Complete visual redesign: a near-black exhibition void where releases hang as hairline plates against an off-centre rail, lit by a single acid-lime accent.
New type system: Instrument Serif wordmark, JetBrains Mono for measurements (index numerals, bit-depth, kHz), Geist for interface text.
The particle background has been replaced with a film-grain field. It can be turned off in Settings → Background.
Search is now a hairline slot that warms to lime on focus, with a lime submit button.
Results animate in with a staggered cascade and show catalogue index numerals; hover reveals technical details behind a lime edge.
Squared corner language throughout: cards, buttons, inputs, dialogs, and the download queue.
Removed the Discord link from the header; the GitHub link now points to the active fork.

title: Native Country Support
changes: Countries can now natively be selected from the country picker (when enabled)! Multiple instances for different countries are no longer needed.

title: Custom Naming Variables & Reset Settings
changes: Added custom naming variables to the settings page. You can now customise the names of downloaded tracks and zip files using special formatting options.
Added reset settings button to the bottom of the settings page.

title: Change Log & PWA Support
changes: Changelog added and now is used to handle updates and fixes along with Discord notifications
Added PWA support for easy access of the site on a mobile device for example with the abilty to add to the homescreen
Changed the border radius style to slightly more rounded, :)
